main_text.p: manifestam impietatis tuæ redargutionem ante cum pascua adhuc erant, que aufus es, igni ter-raque hiatu, teque, tuosque conatus compescere debebamus. Euagrius Histor. lib. 5. cap. 18. Hæreticos quosdam populus diuino quodam zelo incensus, naui piscatoria impositos viuos ignis tradidit incendio. Ioannes Damascenus Dia-logo aduersus Manichæos. Non Manichæos morte afficimus, non flammis absumimus ? Ioannes Zonaras in Historia; Alexius Com-nenus Basilium professione medicum, habitu monachum, Bogomilorum nefariæ sectæ auctorem, deprehensum communi suffragio in equestri Theatro comburi iussit. Cæsa-rius Heisterbachius lib. 5. cap. 19. Sub Ar-noldo Colonia plures sunt Hæretici comprehensi, qui a literatis viris examinati, & victi per iu-dicium seculare damnati sunt, & data sententia duƈti ad ignem. Nec mitiora sunt, quæ tra-dunt Hæretici tui. Philippus Melanchthon Disputatione de delirijs, & furoribus Ana-baptistarum; Cum Anabaptistæ palam sint se-ditiosi, Magistratus publice eos coërcere, ac punire tanquam latrones debent. Theodorus Beza lib. de Hæreticis a ciuili magistratu puniendis. Sed qua pœna fit scelus hoc (hære-seos) vindicandum, quorsum attinet obsecro hu-manis coniecturis probare, cum plura, & aper-ta testimonijs in verbo ipsius legantur. Sic enim ait,

page.notes: Long s transcribed as plain s throughout. Hyphens kept at line ends (Dia-logo, Com-nenus, Cæsa-rius, Ar-noldo, iu-dicium, tra-dunt, Ana-baptistarum, se-ditiosi, hære-seos, hu-manis, aper-ta). The printed s in "scelus" and "sectæ" and the ligature "ƈ" in "duƈti" are reproduced as printed; "duƈti" is possibly "ductí" and marked by the printed spelling only. The word "ait ," on the last line is right-aligned and is the end of the paragraph, not a catchword. The paragraph runs on from the previous page and continues to the page foot, so no paragraph break occurs on this page.
